div.div:
conventions.labels (types/{TYPE}/type.yaml)
every key renders as {LABEL_PREFIX}-...
auto_created created by the pipeline
(new items, not updates)
auto_revised review auto_revised: true
split_original parent that was decomposed
split_result child of a split
needs_attention review needs_attention: true
rubric_pass recommendation = submit
(excluded from auto-fix JQL)
{dimension}.{verdict}
one family per declared
dimension = {VERDICT_LABELS};
rfe: feasibility.feasible /
.infeasible / .indeterminate
a family is mutually exclusive: each submit
adds the matching label and removes the
family's others found in original_labels;
a rejected item has its verdict labels
stripped, with none added
